In King Solomon's "personal diary," as someone has called the Book of Ecclesiastes, this wise king gives us an enumeration of the things he had acquired, but which did not make him rich toward God. All of such, he concluded, "was vanity . . . and there was no profit under the sun." (Eccl. 2:11.)
